name: Indiana 4-H State Fair Exhibit Hall Worker
what_you_do: Paid workers check in and display 4-H exhibits at the Indiana State Fair.
who_can_apply: Age 14 or older; college-age young adults can also work. Workers are expected to live in the reserved dorm space during the job.
deadline_text: 2026 work dates were July 31 to Aug 25 (fair Aug 7 to 23). No application deadline was stated, and 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application linked on the page. Read the schedule for shows with no animals. Email Megan Skiba, skiba0@purdue.edu.
notes: Indiana work permit rules were not checked. Housing is required to be on site.
